PowerShell($envFile = Get-Content ".env.local" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $url = \($envFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=' }\) -replace '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=',''; $key = \($envFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=' }\) -replace '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=',''; if \(-not $url\) { "URL no encontrada en .env.local"; $envFile | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split '='\)[0] } } else { $headers = @{ apikey = $key; Authorization = "Bearer $key" }; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/rest/v1/config_parameters?select=key,value,category&category=eq.whatsapp" -Headers $headers | ConvertTo-Json })
